name: Sunset drinks at Nyhavn
vibe: The most photogenic spot in Copenhagen. Grab a beer from a kiosk, sit on the canal edge, watch the golden light hit the colored houses.

name: Tivoli Gardens after dark
vibe: An amusement park from 1843 that turns into a fairy tale at night. Thousands of lights, roller coasters, live music. Go after 7pm for the atmosphere.

name: Lunch at Reffen street food
vibe: Huge outdoor street food market on the waterfront. Tacos, ramen, BBQ, craft beer — eat with your hands, sit on pallets by the water.

name: Louisiana Museum of Modern Art
vibe: One of the most beautiful museums in Europe. Art, architecture, and the sea all in one. The sculpture garden overlooking the Øresund is unforgettable. 35 min by train.

name: Captain your own boat through the canals
vibe: Rent a solar-powered picnic boat. You're the captain. Bring wine and snacks, cruise the canals for 1-2 hours. No license needed, impossible to mess up.

name: Brunch at Torvehallerne market
vibe: Copenhagen's covered food hall. Fresh pastries, smørrebrød, fancy coffee, and tiny food stalls. Perfect for a slow morning together.

name: Explore Freetown Christiania
vibe: Self-governing commune since 1971. Wild street art, handmade houses, a lake, bars, and a vibe like nowhere else. No photos on Pusher Street. Love it or hate it — you have to see it.

name: Swim at Islands Brygge harbour bath
vibe: Free outdoor harbour pool right in the city. Locals sunbathe, swim, drink coffee. Bring a towel and jump in — the water is surprisingly clean.

name: Hike (or ski!) CopenHill
vibe: A ski slope and hiking trail built on top of a waste-to-energy plant. Designed by Bjarke Ingels. Take the elevator up, walk down the rooftop trail. Views of the whole city.

name: Coffee crawl in Nørrebro
vibe: Copenhagen's most alive neighborhood. Start at The Coffee Collective on Jægersborggade, wander through vintage shops, record stores, and ceramics studios. End with a pastry at Mirabelle.

name: Natural wine in Vesterbro
vibe: Copenhagen's former red-light district is now the coolest food street. Start with natural wine at Pompette or Ved Stranden, end with dinner at Nose2Tail or a kebab at Kødbyens Fiskebar.

name: Walk up the Round Tower
vibe: No stairs — just a wide spiral ramp from 1642 that takes you to the best panoramic view of Copenhagen's colourful rooftops. Quick, fun, and easy.

name: Wander the Christianshavn canals
vibe: Amsterdam vibes but quieter. Houseboats, willow trees, pastel buildings reflected in still water. Grab a coffee at Prolog and just walk.

name: Hang out at Superkilen park
vibe: The weirdest park you'll ever see. Everything in it comes from a different country — Moroccan fountain, Japanese cherry trees, Thai boxing ring. Great for photos.

name: Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek
vibe: Half ancient sculpture museum, half tropical winter garden with palm trees and a fountain. The most romantic rainy-day spot in the city. Free on Tuesdays.

name: Walk around Kastellet fortress
vibe: Star-shaped military fortress from the 1600s, still in use. Grass ramparts, a windmill, a moat, ducks. One of those places tourists walk right past.

name: Cisternerne underground art
vibe: An old Victorian water reservoir turned into a dripping, echoing underground art space. Dark, atmospheric, and completely unexpected beneath a park in Frederiksberg.

name: Picnic in the King's Garden
vibe: Copenhagen's oldest park, right next to Rosenborg Castle. Bring a blanket and pastries from a bakery. Danes do this every sunny day — join them.

name: Botanical Garden & palm house
vibe: A beautiful garden with a massive Victorian glass palm house that feels like stepping into a jungle. Free, quiet, and right in the center.

name: Designmuseum Danmark
vibe: Danish design explained beautifully. Chairs, lamps, posters — everything you'll want to buy when you get home. The building itself is gorgeous.

name: Frederiksberg Have romantic walk
vibe: English landscape garden with canals, bridges, a Chinese pavilion, and herons. Less crowded than the city parks. Bring coffee and get lost in it.

name: Kayak the harbour
vibe: Rent a kayak and paddle through the harbour past the Opera, the Black Diamond library, and under bridges. See the city from the water like the locals do.

name: SMK — National Gallery
vibe: Denmark's biggest art museum. Matisse, Hammershøi, and a killer contemporary wing. Free permanent collection. The park out front is nice for a post-museum sit.

name: Watch the changing of the guard
vibe: The Royal Guard marches from Rosenborg to Amalienborg at noon every day. Quick, free, and surprisingly cinematic. Stay for the palace square.

name: Dinner in the Meatpacking District
vibe: Kødbyen — Copenhagen's old meatpacking district, now full of restaurants and bars. Try Gorilla for sharing plates or BÆST for sourdough pizza with house-made mozzarella.

name: Walk to Paper Island
vibe: Cross the Inderhavnsbroen pedestrian bridge from Nyhavn to Christianshavn. The bridge itself is beautiful, and Paper Island is being rebuilt into something interesting.

name: Rent bikes and ride the city
vibe: Copenhagen is THE bike city. Rent bikes for a day and ride the dedicated lanes. You'll cover 3x more ground and feel like a local instantly.

name: Day trip to Kronborg (Hamlet's castle)
vibe: Shakespeare's Elsinore. A massive Renaissance castle on the tip of Denmark, staring down Sweden across the strait. Dark casemates, grand halls, and a 45-min train ride. Worth the trip.

name: Day trip to Frederiksborg Castle
vibe: Fairy-tale Dutch Renaissance castle reflected in a perfectly still lake. Inside: Denmark's national history museum. Outside: baroque gardens. 40 min by train.

name: The Little Mermaid (just walk past)
vibe: It's tiny and you'll be surrounded by tourists, but you're in Copenhagen so you kind of have to. Go early morning or combine it with Kastellet next door. 30 seconds is enough.

name: Assistens Cemetery — where Danes go to sunbathe
vibe: A cemetery that's also a park. Danes jog, read, and picnic among the graves of Hans Christian Andersen and Kierkegaard. Sounds weird, feels completely normal.

name: Harbour sauna at CopenHot
vibe: Floating saunas and hot tubs in the harbour. Get hot, jump in the cold sea, repeat. Book ahead — it's popular. Best in the late afternoon.

name: Jægersborggade — the best street in CPH
vibe: One tiny street in Nørrebro packed with ceramics studios, a sake bar, a chocolate factory, and The Coffee Collective. The most Copenhagen street in Copenhagen.

name: Wine & swimming at La Banchina
vibe: A tiny natural wine bar on the water with a sauna and a dock to swim from. Order a glass, go for a dip, come back. Only in Copenhagen.

name: Wander Strøget to Nytorv
vibe: Europe's longest pedestrian street. Skip the chain shops, duck into the side streets — that's where the good stuff hides. End at Nytorv square for people-watching.

name: Rosenborg Castle & the crown jewels
vibe: A 400-year-old castle in the middle of a park. Inside: the crown jewels, royal furniture, and a long table that makes you feel tiny. Small enough to not feel like a museum death march.
